title: Predicting Chronic Post-Surgical Pain After Anal Fistula Surgery Using Perioperative Clinical and Anesthesia Data: A Machine Learning Study.
summary: Perioperative-data models predicted chronic postsurgical pain after anal fistula surgery, using a held-out test set with 19 outcome cases; performance is therefore preliminary. The result is reported in the Journal of Pain Research. It does not establish generalization beyond the reported setting or prospective real-world benefit.
